how_we_lost: P2 (Sephiroth) killed us on round 11 (turn 43), heads-up. Our Coming of Galactus token had already killed P3 (round 10) and P1 (round 10), and P2 had fallen to about 18. We were at 5 life because Sephiroth's emblem drains 1 on every creature death, and it had been bleeding us since round 8. On turn 42 both memos said to recast Spore Frog. Instead the pilot recast Executioner's Capsule, which had no legal target because every P2 creature was black, then Walking Ballista through the creature lane, so the Frog was locked out. P2 attacked with Zodiark, Zombie tokens and Faeries. Muldrotha blocked Zodiark, and 7 unblocked damage finished us.
winnable_why: We had a real line to the end. A 16/16 flying, trampling Galactus plus a recast saga (chapters II and III drain 2 each) had P2 at about 18. One more Spore Frog fog would have given us the next swing: chapter II for 2 plus about 15 trample through a Faerie chump, which is lethal or within a Ballista ping of it. Earlier, executor tempo losses left Muldrotha in play for only one turn before round 10: Signet was held for three turns, Muldrotha traded in combat the turn after she landed, and she wasn't recast on round 9. A strong human pilot likely closes this.

mistakes.what_happened: Round 11, at 5 life against P2's five attackers. Both the start-of-turn memo and the escalation memo said to recast Spore Frog from the graveyard for a fog. The executor accepted Forge's line instead. It cast Executioner's Capsule from the graveyard, which used the artifact lane and had no target, since all of P2's creatures are black. Then it cast Walking Ballista, which had to go through the creature lane, and pinged P2's face for 1. The Frog could not be cast, and P2's alpha strike killed us.
mistakes.better_play: Cast Spore Frog ({G}) with the creature lane. If Ballista is cast at all, send it through the artifact lane instead of the dead Capsule. Sacrifice Frog in P2's combat, then swing Galactus again next turn.
mistakes.why: The fog was the only thing between us and lethal. Next turn's Galactus swing plus chapter II had P2 dead or nearly dead.

mistakes.what_happened: The round 4, 5 and 6 memos each said to cast Arcane Signet first. The executor instead cast Baleful Strix + Spore Frog on round 4. On round 5 it cast Kaya's Ghostform on Baleful Strix, breaking the explicit HOLD that reserved it for Muldrotha, plus Grist. On round 6 it cast The Coming of Galactus. Signet was not cast until round 7.
mistakes.better_play: Cast Signet + Strix on round 4 as planned. That gives 5 mana on round 5 (Grist + Doc, or Galactus) and Muldrotha on round 6 with Ghostform held for her.
mistakes.why: The delay pushed Muldrotha from about round 6 to round 8 and wasted the one card meant to protect her. Every later problem happened with the engine offline.

mistakes.what_happened: In P1's combat, the round after Muldrotha landed, P1 attacked us with a 10/10 Orc Army, Sauron and a Nazgûl. The memo said to sacrifice Spore Frog to fog if the Army swung at us. The executor double-blocked the Army with Strix (deathtouch alone kills it) and Frog. It also overruled Forge's no-block to put Muldrotha in front of Sauron (7/6). Muldrotha, Frog and Strix died (Ghostform returned Strix), and Muldrotha's tax rose to 8.
mistakes.better_play: Sacrifice Frog for a fog and keep everything. Failing that, block the Army with Strix alone and keep Muldrotha out of combat.
mistakes.why: The trade killed Sauron and the Army, which had real value. But Muldrotha had produced one land drop and one Frog, and she stayed off the table for rounds 9 and 10, when the graveyard engine was the plan.

mistakes.what_happened: Round 9. The memo said to tap all 8 sources to recast Muldrotha and cast nothing else. The executor cast Doc Aurlock, Eternal Witness and a 1-counter Walking Ballista instead. It also overruled Forge's Witness target, taking back Verdant Catacombs instead of Grist. P1's Too Greedily, Too Deep then killed Witness and Strix (Ballista was already gone), and the Sephiroth emblem drained us for each death.
mistakes.better_play: Recast Muldrotha as planned. If casting Witness, return Grist, a planeswalker we could otherwise only recast with Muldrotha.
mistakes.why: It lost another round of Muldrotha, and the three small creatures became emblem-drain liabilities that cost us life we needed at the end.

mistakes.what_happened: Galactus's attack trigger ('destroy target land') was aimed at our own Forest, overruling Forge's choice of P2's Nykthos. The memo's plan to aim at our uncracked Catacombs was already void, because the Catacombs had been cracked before combat.
mistakes.better_play: Destroy P2's Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
mistakes.why: We lost a land in the cycle where we needed 8 sources for Muldrotha, and P2 kept the devotion land that fuels Zodiark and a Sephiroth recast.

mistakes.what_happened: Shriekmaw sat in hand from round 5 to the end, and Executioner's Capsule was dead on the battlefield or recast with no target. Every opposing creature all game was black: Sauron's Orcs and Nazgûl, Sephiroth, Zodiark, Y'shtola, Vito and the Zombie and Faerie tokens.
mistakes.better_play: Nothing to do in-game. At deck level, recurring creature removal needs an unconditional option, such as a Ravenous Chupacabra-style ETB kill or an edict, not two nonblack-only effects.
mistakes.why: Two of the deck's recurring removal pieces were blanks against this pod, which is why the late game had no answer to Zodiark or the token swarm.

strategy_assessment: The memos read the table correctly: Sephiroth and Sauron were the fast threats, and The Coming of Galactus was the right win path. The Galactus token and saga drains made the P1 and P3 eliminations happen. Late-game strategy was also sound: minimise creature deaths under Sephiroth's emblem, fog P2's combats, and race with Galactus. The plan failed in execution, not design. The executor broke the memo at nearly every key point: Signet timing, Ghostform, the fog on the Sauron swing, the Muldrotha recast, and the final Frog. The only strategist quibble is that finishing P3 on round 10 cost Ballista plus 6 mana and a Muldrotha turn, when P3 at 2 life was probably going to die to P2's emblem anyway. The right overall plan was to develop mana on schedule, land Muldrotha around round 6 behind Ghostform and Frog, then loop Galactus while fogging.
summary: We lost heads-up to P2 on round 11 after our Galactus token eliminated P3 and P1. P2 was at about 18, facing a 16/16 flier and saga drains. At 5 life the executor used the creature lane on Walking Ballista instead of recasting Spore Frog, and P2's wide swing killed us. That caps a game of executor deviations from sound memos: Signet held three turns, Muldrotha traded the turn she landed and wasn't recast on round 9.
